# ITD System Maintenance Requirements

This document details essential tasks for maintaining the bank's IT infrastructure.

## Firewall Management
*   Update firewall settings quarterly.
*   Optimize firewall settings quarterly.
*   Update firewall settings urgently.
*   Optimize firewall settings (standard update).

## API Monitoring
*   Monitor API latency quarterly.
